title: Obscur - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Obscur in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Immune to Dark and weak to Light, the inverse of Clair. The pair share a boss form, the Clair Obscur.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight
ResistsNone
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneDark

Bring Light damage. Dark does nothing at all.

sections.title: How to Beat the Obscur
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It is immune to Dark, which will do nothing at all.
